sub.title: The Blood Warfare
sub.description: The Gotei 13 investigates strange occurrences in the Human World and the Rukongai as Ichigo Kurosaki and Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto are confronted by mysterious enemies.

sub.title: Foundation Stones
sub.description: Nel Tu finds Ichigo Kurosaki in Karakura Town and reveals that Hueco Mundo has been conquered by the Wandenreich, prompting Ichigo and his friends to decide that they must help the Arrancar.

sub.title: March of the Starcross
sub.description: Ichigo Kurosaki begins battling Sternritter "J" Quilge Opie while the Gotei 13 prepares for war against the Wandenreich.

sub.title: Kill the Shadow
sub.description: The war between the Gotei 13 and the Wandenreich begins as the captains discover the true power of the Medallions used by the Sternritter.

sub.title: Wrath as a Lightning
sub.description: Quilge Opie uses his power to imprison Ichigo inside the Garganta. As he tries to break free, Ichigo begins to hear, through his Soul Phone, the screams of the Soul Reapers falling to the enemy's onslaught.

sub.title: The Fire
sub.description: Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto battles Yhwach and activates his Bankai for the first time in 1,000 years.

sub.title: Born in the Dark
sub.description: With Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto being cut down by Yhwach, Ichigo Kurosaki finally enters Soul Society to confront the latter.

sub.title: The Shooting Star Project (Zero Mix)
sub.description: In the aftermath of the Wandenreich's first invasion, the Gotei 13 tends to its wounded as the Royal Guard come to help rebuild.

sub.title: The Drop
sub.description: Ichigo Kurosaki continues moving through the Royal Guard's palaces with 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai as Captain-Commander Shunsui Kyōraku decides to have 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki be taught Zanjutsu by 4th Division Captain Retsu Unohana.

sub.title: The Battle
sub.description: 11th Division Captain Kenpachi Zaraki concludes his battle against 4th Division Captain Retsu Unohana as Ichigo Kurosaki and 6th Division Lieutenant Renji Abarai meet Ōetsu Nimaiya, the creator of the Zanpakutō

sub.title: Everything but the Rain
sub.description: Isshin Kurosaki recounts his history with Masaki Kurosaki to Ichigo Kurosaki.

sub.title: Everything but the Rain "June Truth"
sub.description: When Masaki Kurosaki begins undergoing Hollowfication from the wound inflicted by White, 10th Division Captain Isshin Shiba is given a chance by Kisuke Urahara to save her life.

sub.title: The Blade Is Me
sub.description: With newfound resolve, Ichigo Kurosaki returns to the Hōōden to have his Zanpakutō reforged by Ōetsu Nimaiya.
